title: Step Equality When Query Answers Agree
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine, let $O,O'$ be languages over its symbol alphabet, and let $c$ be a configuration. Suppose that whenever $c$ is in the query state, its query string belongs to $O$ if and only if it belongs to $O'$. Then one step from $c$ relative to $O$ equals one step from $c$ relative to $O'$.
hypotheses_covered: Two oracle languages $O,O'$ over the symbol alphabet
If $c$ is in the query state, the two languages agree on its query string
